A Q2 2026 8-K on file (filed 2026-08-05, fetched 2026-09-04) discloses that Albemarle sold a 51% (controlling) stake in Ketjen's refining catalyst solutions business, announced 2026-03-02: the business is now equity-accounted, folded into Corporate, and its earnings contribution is described as expected to be immaterial post-transaction.
